title: [tenmin-redispatch] priorConsecutiveFailures: characterization test for empty lists, cancelled runs and non-dispatch runs
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for priorConsecutiveFailures in src/tenmin-redispatch.ts: failure streak edges
- priorConsecutiveFailures([]) is 0
- priorConsecutiveFailures([{ id: 3, event: "workflow_dispatch", status: "completed", conclusion: "cancelled", display_title: "Scanner" }, { id: 2, event: "workflow_dispatch", status: "completed", conclusion: "failure", display_title: "Scanner" }]) is 0
- priorConsecutiveFailures([{ id: 3, event: "schedule", status: "completed", conclusion: "success", display_title: "Scanner" }, { id: 2, event: "workflow_dispatch", status: "completed", conclusion: "failure", display_title: "Scanner" }]) is 1
- priorConsecutiveFailures([{ id: 2, event: "workflow_dispatch", status: "completed", conclusion: "failure", display_title: "Scanner" }, { id: 1, event: "workflow_dispatch", status: "completed", conclusion: "failure", display_title: "Scanner" }]) is 2

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v4): Peace's task (source: peace). priorConsecutiveFailures is tested with a self id and restarter titles; an empty list, a cancelled run ending the streak, a schedule run being skipped and the count with no self id are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS ef9778e (Workspace main 3670cd8, live 27-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v4); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with priorConsecutiveFailures stubbed); suite 598/598 with all thirteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
